item.title: Quintodrome 1.0.0-alpha.19
item.description:
Desktop: Check for Updates says when an update is queued for quit

With automatic updates on, Sparkle downloads an update silently and installs
it when the app quits; Check for Updates… then showed nothing at all. Now it
says the version is ready and installs on quit, with Quit Now / Later.
